title: Nutritious Filipino Anchovy Fillet Lumpia
description: A comforting Filipino dish featuring anchovy fillet, steam, and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, wrapped in a lumpia form, with a bitter and molten flavor profile.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and saute until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and saute for 1 minute.
Add the chopped anchovy fillet and cook until heated through.
Add the chopped patola and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Lay a lumpia wrapper on a flat surface and place 1 tablespoon of the anchovy mixture in the center.
Brush the edges with water and fold the wrapper into a triangle.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Steam the lumpia over boiling water for 10 minutes.
